messages.subject: INLA error - post
parts:
Dear team,

(1) I was trying to sample from a model fitted and saved in an image file using the following command. Currently I am using R 4.2.2 (2022-10-31 ucrt) and INLA (INLA_22.12.12-1 built 2022-12-11 21:53:09 UTC.) for windows.  For your kind information it was working fine with earlier version of Rx64 4.1.3 and R-INLA. 

(2) Also, after installing the latest version of R-INLA (22.12.12-1) under R for windows v R 4.2.2, the RStudio takes a long time to load. May I request the team to help me out on the above two issues. 

> xx35 <- inla.posterior.sample(1000, model_bym2.rw1.t4)
